subject.title: fix: Responses streams mishandle interleaved output items and silent truncation

question: Should every Responses adapter disable implicit OpenAI SDK retries by default and make the caller or application retry layer the sole retry owner?
rationale: The change removes an existing SDK availability fallback for direct library callers while retaining a separate ChatGPT default, so the permanent cross-adapter retry contract requires owner intent rather than inference from tests.

options.title: Use one outer retry owner
options.body: Keep SDK retries disabled, ensure all supported entry points provide the intended outer retry budget, and add focused direct-caller and stacked-retry coverage.

options.title: Preserve direct-call retries
options.body: Retain the SDK's prior default when no explicit retry budget is supplied, while passing zero only from application paths that already own retries.

recommendation.title: Use one outer retry owner
recommendation.body: Keep SDK retries disabled, ensure all supported entry points provide the intended outer retry budget, and add focused direct-caller and stacked-retry coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest adjacent provider-history signal and authored the proposed retry-policy change.
